supported_bounded_claims: A clean exact-scoped integrated request can produce eligibility to invoke an isolated execution gateway only after exact qualification and use-time external capability validation.
Qualification epoch drift, revocation, and expiry fail closed.
Model-requested scope widening is retained as evidence and does not become authority.
Capability revocation or expiry at use time denies execution eligibility.
Action or artifact widening fails closed.
Human-required decisions cannot be bypassed by model success claims or skip requests.
Review-required states do not become execution authorization.
Terminal actions remain behind a separate external gate.
Unsafe model authority attempts remain evidence-eligible without gaining authority.
Clean replay of the same bound request is deterministic.
claim_boundary: A positive Slice 1 result is an authorization/evidence record indicating eligibility to invoke an isolated execution gateway. Slice 1 itself performs no consequential side effect and does not mint terminal authority.
nonclaims: release, deploy, merge, production, completion, or self-issued authority
retained_hygiene: Historical subprocess ResourceWarnings remain visible in the full regression log; they did not fail the frozen run and are not treated as proof of mechanism correctness.
next_target: Integrated Governed MVP Slice 2: isolated execution gateway consuming the exact Slice 1 bound decision with fresh use-time capability/state validation, durable idempotency, crash/retry/restart safety, exact effect/result lineage, and no terminal-authority laundering.
